thread:
anya: Quick thread from design review  small but recurring customer nit: CSV/JSON export of audit logs uses short column headers like 'kms' and 'ret' which confuse compliance teams. cc @dina @rory

dina: Oof. We thought shorter headers helped tooling but compliance folks expect human-readable headers. Propose full headers: 'Key management' and 'Retention period (days)'.

rory: +1. Also request from legal: include 'region' spelled out as 'Region (geo)' in exports and add a separate 'encryption_type' column rather than lumping flags into one cell.

a11y-bot: Accessibility note (export preview in UI): screen reader announces "table with 5 columns" but column headers like 'kms' are ambiguous. Use full text for headers and ensure aria-describedby links to a short export legend.

sam: Implementation note: CSV generator lives in infra-service, changing headers is trivial, but we need a migration plan for downstream customers parsing by header name. Recommend adding both old and new headers for 3 months, plus a deprecation note in the export UI modal.

dina: Draft copy for modal: "Export includes human-readable headers for compliance teams. Deprecated short headers (e.g., 'kms') are included for compatibility through 2026-07-01." Thoughts?
any: typo, I'm rory not ryan :P

rory: Looks good. Add link to docs and a sample payload in modal: small code block showing new headers. Also add a checkbox "Include deprecated headers for compatibility" so power users can opt out.

a11y-bot: For checkbox state changes, send live region update: role="status" text = "Export settings updated" so screen reader users know their choice saved. Also ensure focus lands on the confirm button after toggling options.

anya: Nice. Outcome: change export headers to full names, include deprecated keys for 3 months behind opt-out checkbox, add deprecation copy and docs link, add aria-describedby for export preview, and ensure live region announce. Dina will PR copy + UI. Sam will file infra task to add headers and backward compat. Rory will update docs.

dina: I'll stub the PR today with copy + modal sample and a11y notes. ETA EOD.

sam: Created infra ticket INFRA-1287. Linking to this thread.

anya: Thanks all, closing unless objections. :thumbsup:
